title: Certify a counterexample to the P104 arrival-shape price premise
body:
## Summary

Certify a counterexample to the arrival-shape premise in Philippe Van Velzen's pinned [P104 relay-v2 cost screen](https://github.com/philippeVV/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fac9e821d31bc199b49e8ed463074a50d1264311/research/p104-correction-screen/relay-v2/README.md). A dirty helper can follow:

```text
ZERO -> source line -> target hyperplane -> FULL
   1              7                    1
```

Initial target compensation and final source cleanup restore arbitrary helper dirt. The complete correction uses 4,992 such carriers. This refutes the claim that arrival helpers cannot have histogram `{1,1,7}`, which was used to justify a uniform 463-lifetime limit. It does not construct a feasible design above 463 or disprove that numerical limit by another argument.

Add one opt-in package, `research/p104-arrival-shape-audit/`, with proof, generator/interpreter, exact receipt, source pins, behavioral controls and export for the predecessor checker. The deliberately expensive word adds 44,928 rank units, so it fails the fixed-template allowance. The conservative necessary condition remains `9L <= 4344`, hence `L <= 482`. No supplier, improved moment or new kappa.

Card `p104-side-correction`, revision 4, refined to this pricing implication. Base and refreshed canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; tested contribution head is `f234bd0e5dca545aacbaaa457bd606e17de95baf`. [Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18952536). Final overlap covered 799 open PRs and 1,252 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; metadata searches omit arbitrary code diffs.

## Evidence

- **Before:** relay-v2 excludes `{1,1,7}` arrival histories and assigns a uniform four-step price.
  **After:** exact replay checks all 39,002 combined events and all 5,272 independent original/dirty inputs. Every source and helper restores; each target ends at `Y_t + X_t`. Added profile is `9984 H1 + 4992 H7`.
- The predecessor's unmodified checker independently accepts the exported correction: `PASS_P104_RELAY_CONSTRUCTION lifetimes=4992 per_target=48.00 line_floor=208 idle_cap=482`. Its PASS checks grammar/endpoints, not budget admission. Exact source commit and checker hash are retained in TASK.json.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and nine behavioral groups pass. Controls cover dirty compensation, coefficient/delivery/cleanup faults, frames/ranks/monotonicity, chronology, input/capacity limits and exclusive output. Optimized Git-free CPython 3.14.8 replay and Ruff 0.17.1 diagnostics pass. All 65 research workflow tests pass, with three skips.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-arrival-shape-audit
```

Native transports/phases, physical precision, scalar/address lowering, hosting/idle pricing, all-size admission, PR2559 repricing and the selected cold replay are unrun. No human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

Credit Philippe Van Velzen for relay-v2 and its cost question; retain kumagi/PR2353, Gonzalo Mier/PR2393, Ross Richardson/PR2445 and the Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071 and Ali Romman/PR1125 lineage. PR2594's independent endpoint/growth audit concerns a different claim. Existing source notices are preserved; Apache-2.0.

The next question is a valid joint constraint on actual helper contact dimensions, with this carrier retained as a positive case, or a cheaper complete correction with its full bill.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One new registered research package. Selected frontier, frozen predecessors and shared verifier code are unchanged.
